text: I had not courage to walk straight into the apartment; but I desired to divert him from his reverie, and therefore fell foul of the kitchen fire, stirred it, and began to scrape the cinders. It drew him forth sooner than I expected. He opened the door immediately, and said—“Nelly, come here—is it morning? Come in with your light.” “It is striking four,” I answered. “You want a candle to take upstairs: you might have lit one at this fire.” “No, I don’t wish to go upstairs,” he said.
